commands.label: verified-runtime-api-os-metadata
command:
printf '===os-release===\n'
if [ -r /etc/os-release ]; then cat /etc/os-release; fi
printf '\n===apk===\n'
if [ -r /lib/apk/db/installed ]; then cat /lib/apk/db/installed; fi
printf '\n===dpkg===\n'
if command -v dpkg-query >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 dpkg_fmt='${binary:Package}\t${Version}\t${Architecture}'
 dpkg_fmt="$dpkg_fmt"'\t${source:Package}\t${source:Version}\n'
 dpkg-query -W -f="$dpkg_fmt"
fi
printf '\n===dpkg-licenses===\n'
for copyright_path in /usr/share/doc/*/copyright; do
 [ -r "$copyright_path" ] || continue
 package_path=${copyright_path%/copyright}
 printf '%s\t' "${package_path##*/}"
 awk '/^License:/ {gsub(/\t/, " "); printf "%s;", $0}' "$copyright_path"
 printf '\n'
done
printf '\n===rpm===\n'
if command -v rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\t%{LICENSE}\n'
fi

commands.label: verified-runtime-api-python-metadata
command:
import importlib.metadata as m, json, sys
packages=[]
for d in m.distributions():
    h=d.metadata
    packages.append({"name":h.get("Name",""), "version":d.version,
        "license_expression":h.get("License-Expression",""),
        "license":h.get("License","")[:4096],
        "classifiers":h.get_all("Classifier") or [],
        "location":str(d._path)})
print(json.dumps({"interpreter":sys.executable,"python_version":sys.version,
    "packages":packages},sort_keys=True))

api.deduplication_method: Python normalized name/version dedup; lib/lib64 aliases
api.inventory_scope: installed package-manager metadata only; excludes undiscovered/static binaries and full file tree

langflow.deduplication_method: Python normalized name/version dedup; lib/lib64 aliases
langflow.inventory_scope: installed package-manager metadata only; excludes undiscovered/static binaries and full file tree

web.deduplication_method: Python normalized name/version dedup; lib/lib64 aliases
web.inventory_scope: installed package-manager metadata only; excludes undiscovered/static binaries and full file tree

limitations: Remote vulnerability services do not expose reproducible database snapshot dates.
Metadata SBOM is not a complete filesystem/static-binary scan.
License metadata is not legal approval; unknown/restricted licenses need review.
P0/P1 local release evidence does not establish production readiness.

candidate_revisions.method: dedup duplicate npm bom-ref; union dependsOn edges per ref
fill missing license using exact locked package version in final API image
